correctness.rationale: On the 6-vertex, 12-edge graph, exhaustive source-degree-two coefficient extraction of product(t_a+/-t_b) yields 38 balanced orientations and all 144 moments; verified source coefficient DP and independent enumeration of all 4096 direction patterns match. With signed incidence B, the pseudoinverse L+ has exact eigenvalue weights 1/4 (within-pair contrasts) and 1/6 (pair-constant contrasts); P_cyc=I-B^T L+ B. v is a 12-entry unit-sign circulation, v^Tv=12. Formula gives eigenvalues 32/19 sixfold and 36/19 once on 7D cycle space, zero fivefold; K5 is the unique five-vertex quartic graph and its frame is tight 5/3 P_cyc. Graph complement of perfect matching proves uniqueness at 6 vertices.
